5.0.SP2.description: Secondary allocation identifier. Unlike the AllocID <70> , this can be shared across a number of allocation instruction or allocation report messages, thereby making it possible to pass an identifier for an original allocation message on multiple messages (e.g. from one party to a second to a third, across cancel and replace messages etc.).
